input: Get a professional watch battery replaced today

gold.taskTitle: Get a professional watch battery replaced today
gold.taskDescription: Find a suitable service provider and get the battery in a watch professionally replaced on the same day.

questions.title: What brand and model is the watch?
questions.description: Knowing the brand and model helps identify specialist requirements, compatible batteries, and whether a luxury or standard repair shop is needed.

questions.title: Is this a luxury, fashion, or everyday watch?
questions.description: The tier of the watch determines which type of service provider is appropriate and what level of care is expected during the replacement.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood are you located in?
questions.description: Location is essential for finding nearby same-day battery replacement services.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred type of service provider?
questions.description: The user may prefer an authorized dealer, an independent watchmaker, a jewelry store, or a kiosk such as a mall watch repair stand.

questions.title: Does the watch require a water-resistance re-seal after?
questions.description: Some watches need pressure testing and re-sealing after a battery change, which not all shops can perform and affects which provider to choose.

questions.title: What is your budget for this repair?
questions.description: Battery replacement costs range widely depending on the provider and watch type, so knowing the budget helps filter suitable options.

questions.title: Is there a specific time window you need it done by?
questions.description: Knowing if there is a hard deadline within the day helps prioritize providers that offer walk-in or express service.
